title: Cam Skattebo stayed in his stance instead of pushing Jameis Winston's tush on key play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo stayed in his stance instead of pushing Jameis Winston's tush on key play
sources.description: Giants running back Cam Skattebo stayed in his stance and didn't participate in the play on a key short-yardage snap late in the Giants' loss on Thursday night.
